value.rationale: This is an exact two-parameter law for a natural one-edge departure from a dense bipartite interaction network, with a structural mechanism showing how a triangle source supersedes a four-cycle source. The triangular-book (\(p=2\)) case exhibits an all-size disappearance of the intermediate phase and precisely six new active states relative to the original bipartite network. The effect is not a mere restatement of a general cycle-rate criterion; it uses a complete finite type classification and nontrivial support-source inclusion-exclusion.
